slices.1_clip_pan: folio StudioAudioRouting.clip_pans (StudioClipPanEnvelope {clip_id, points [{offset_ticks, pan}]}, additive, absent not encoded); pulse TimelineMixStream::with_clip_envelopes (clip lane clamp(track pan + pan) at the points, linear between, held outside); bus_mix strips: panned mono clips move to the stereo strip (panned by score's equal-power law inside, track pan as balance after); timeline Clip Pan lane (LaneTarget::ClipPan, typed AddPoint/MovePoint/DeletePoint, entry-only step); envelopes.rs follows clip_pans with clip_gains in the edit's submit_sequence_and_entry step
slices.2_master_row: folio StudioAudioMaster.volume_automation (Vec<StudioAutomationPoint>, additive); pulse bus_mix master fader lane; timeline master row (MASTER_ROW = "master", layout_full, TimelineLayout.master) with Volume lane and master effect parameter lanes (instance keyframes, as bus effects); mixdown path unchanged (TimelineBusStream)
slices.3_automated_fader: Studio reading: a fader move on an automated control WRITES THE LANE AT THE PLAYHEAD (timeline playhead floored to the mixer sample grid; replaces a point at that tick) as one entry-only step (mixer_volume_lane / mixer_pan_lane / mixer_master_volume_lane); static field untouched; refusals fader_automated_no_playhead, outside_sequence, value range. Visible state: amber 'AUTO lane <v> at playhead' label (widgets mixer.<track>.volume.automated / .pan.automated / mixer.master.volume.automated) and volume_automated / pan_automated / lane_volume_db / lane_pan in mixer_json

declared_readings: clip pan in the plain TimelineMixStream: lane = clamp(track pan + clip pan) per point (bus mix: track pan 0 inside the strip, so the lane is the envelope)

panned mono clip: equal-power clip pan, then the track pan acts as stereo balance (unpanned mono keeps the equal-power track pan); a crossfade between panned and unpanned mono clips is audio_unsupported
master has no pan lane (Folio/score store none): lane_unavailable
fader under automation writes the lane at the playhead (not refused)

lead_answers_20261030.1_mono_clip_pan: ACCEPTED as a Studio reading: clip pan places mono into stereo by pulse's existing pan law (score equal-power), then the track pan acts as balance on that stereo result; Audition UNVERIFIED (D5)
lead_answers_20261030.2_panned_unpanned_crossfade: the preferred stereo-sides crossfade does not fit: plan_clips applies crossfades only between consecutive cuts of one TimelineMixStream, and bus_mix splits a track into per-class strips (mono strip consumed as one channel), so the two sides live in different streams; rendering them needs the strip split restructured. Kept typed audio_unsupported; detail named by pulse strip_crossfade_mismatch (case panned_unpanned_mono_crossfade | mono_stereo_crossfade, track, outgoing, incoming) and shown in the mixer error/status
lead_answers_20261030.3_master_row_test: if master_row_lanes_edit_and_play fails only on the 260 px panel height, the test sizes its window/panel; the product default stays

engine_gaps_for_lead: crossfade between a panned and an unpanned mono clip (and between mono and stereo clips) on one track: refused audio_unsupported (strip_crossfade_mismatch names it); rendering needs both sides as stereo in one strip, i.e. a restructured bus_mix strip split (pulse)
PulseError is a Copy unit enum without a detail field: the case is reported through strip_crossfade_mismatch, not inside the error value
